# SYN6004AA fixture brief (fixture-only synthetic)

Module: SYN6004AA International Supply Chain Management
Assessment: individual report, 4000 words (plus or minus 10%), excluding tables, figures, and references.
Question: How can a named supply chain integrate sustainability for competitive advantage, and why does that matter in a recession?

Use one named supply chain. The fixture allow-list is Inditex/Zara, Toyota, Tesla, Nestle, Unilever, Apple, Samsung, Pfizer, AstraZeneca, or a comparable chain you name.

Required task:
- drivers of sustainability-centric supply chain management
- benefits of integrating sustainability
- integration into supply chain management for competitive advantage
- recession relevance

Section weights:

| Section | Weight |
| --- | ---: |
| Introduction | 5% |
| Drivers of sustainability-centric SCM | 20% |
| Benefits of integrating sustainability | 20% |
| Integration to competitive advantage | 30% |
| Recession relevance | 10% |
| Conclusion | 5% |
| Presentation and referencing | 10% |

Use at least one specialist industry source (Statista, Lloyd's List, Clarksons, FT, or CILT Focus).
